verdict.rationale: Stripe documents machine payments that let agents pay for APIs and services programmatically, including stablecoin payments over the x402 protocol, so an agent-initiated stablecoin payment flow exists. Nothing in the evidence shows human-configured spend limits, scoped authority, or agent-initiated payouts. The x402 docs read mainly as the merchant side accepting agent payments. missing for 10: documented human-configured spend controls or scoped authority for agents, agent-initiated stablecoin payout flows, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent stablecoin payments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can move stablecoins under scoped authority — documented agent payment flows where an agent initiates a payment or payout with spend controls a human configured

citations.quote: Machine payments let agents pay for APIs and services programmatically.
Stripe also supports stablecoin payments over the x402 protocol.
For stablecoin payments, the minimum amount is 0.01 USDC.
